findings.evidence: The PR itself needs the private lemma at lines 65-70 and 105-108; the only existing public lemma found by grep is `characteristicLowerFaceExponent_natCast` in `CubeGenerator.lean:261`, which rewrites to `C.eraseDirection v`, not to `C.lowerFace v hv`.
findings.fix: Expose this lemma publicly, preferably near the bundled face-exponent API in `CubeGenerator.lean`, so downstream proofs can rewrite lower-face exponents against `C.lowerFace v hv` without using the body of `lowerFace`.
findings.issue: `characteristicLowerFaceExponent_natCast_lowerFace` is private, leaving no public cast-to-weight-difference lemma for the actual `C.lowerFace v hv` API; consumers must unfold `lowerFace_def` to telescope lower-face exponents.

summary: The square equalities are in scope, but the PR leaves a lower-face exponent characterization private even though downstream users need that public API to reason without unfolding `lowerFace`.
